subject: Vendor onboarding: payment terms alignment & early-pay exception request
messages:
From: Sana Roy <sana.roy@lumaplex.co>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.bennett@lumaplex.co
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: early-pay pilot request + PO header confirmation

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We are finalizing our vendor intake for LumaPlex and want to confirm two things before we return the forms:

1) Payment terms: our treasury team prefers Net 30 but has asked whether Redwood offers an early-pay enrollment or accelerated remittance (we can discuss a commercial incentive).
2) PO headers and required invoice fields — we use a two-line PO with ServiceCode and ProjectID in the PO notes; our AP platform requires explicit mapping for electronic invoices. Is there a standard PO header template Redwood requires?

If possible, we'd like to be enrolled in an "early remit" trial for Q4 (one or two invoices) — we can offer a 0.75% fee for earlier remittance if Redwood's finance ops is open to a pilot.

I've attached the completed vendor onboarding form and our AP profile for fields that need mapping.

Attachments: lumaplex_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF), lumaplex_ap_profile.xlsx (XLSX), lumaplex_w9.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Sana Roy
Head of Partnerships & Finance Liaison
LumaPlex

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Roy <sana.roy@lumaplex.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyab_natarajan@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: early-pay pilot request + PO header confirmation

Hi Sana — welcome, and thanks for sending over the forms. Quick notes and next steps so we can move this to finance: 

- Payment terms: standard onboarding is Net 45 for new suppliers, but we do have an early-pay pilot program managed by AP that can be used for one-off invoices. Enrollment requires approval from Finance and Vendor Ops.
- PO headers: attached is our PO header template (see note below). We need ProjectID to map to our billing key; ServiceCode can go in the description field.

Action items:
- Marissa (Vendor Ops) — can you validate the attached vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and confirm the PO header mapping?
- David (Finance) — can you confirm whether we can accept a 0.75% early-remit fee for a pilot and whether Net 30 from LumaPlex can be accommodated for verified invoices?

Sana, I'll loop in Vendor Ops and Finance and get back with the decision by Tuesday. If finance approves the pilot, we'll ask AP for the enrollment form and a short commercial addendum.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Partnerships (Onboarding)
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: Sana Roy <sana.roy@lumaplex.co>, david_kim@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: early-pay pilot request + PO header confirmation

Evelyn / Sana — I validated the onboarding form and did a quick field map against our invoice processor. Summary: 

- ProjectID: good. We'll map to our internal billing_key (field: X-Project-ID). Requires exact match (case sensitive).
- ServiceCode: Lumaplex should put ServiceCode in the invoice line-item reference (we will copy to description).
- Required invoice fields: Invoice#, PO#, Date, Line amount, Tax (if applicable).

Regarding payment cadence: we can accept Net 30 only if Finance approves the exception for the first 90 days and if LumaPlex agrees to electronic submission via our portal (no paper). For the early-pay fee, AP typically negotiates a discount to Redwood's receivable schedule rather than an added fee; we can structure as a one-time early-settlement addendum with a discount applied.

Sana — please confirm you can submit invoices via our vendor portal (https://vendor.redwood.com/invoice). If yes, I'll submit the intake for a Net30 exception + early-settle pilot to Finance and include the proposed commercial terms.

Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@lumaplex.co>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: Sana Roy <sana.roy@lumaplex.co>, ap@lumaplex.co
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: early-pay pilot request + PO header confirmation

Thanks Marissa — we can absolutely submit via your portal. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- The ProjectID is case sensitive; we'll make sure it matches exactly.
- For the early settlement, we would prefer the arrangement to be framed as an accelerated remit option (we pay a small fee to get paid earlier) rather than a discount to Redwood. Treasury will accept either structure but prefers the fee model for reporting.

If Finance needs a single example invoice for the pilot, we can schedule a test invoice next week (Sept 27) once you confirm the portal mapping.

Regards,
Tom Bennett
Director, Global AP
LumaPlex

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@lumaplex.co>, Sana Roy <sana.roy@lumaplex.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: early-pay pilot request + PO header confirmation

Tom / Sana — quick update from Finance after review: 

- Finance approved a 90-day Net 30 exception for LumaPlex contingent on portal submission and a signed commercial addendum for the early-remit pilot.
- Regarding the fee vs discount: Finance prefers a discount structure (reduces invoice amount) for accounting simplicity, but will accept a fee model if LumaPlex requires it. For parity, the equivalent discount will be ~0.65% applied as a one-line early-settlement deduction on the paid invoice.
- Next steps: Marissa will send the PO header template and the portal access step-by-step. I'll send a short addendum template (DocuSign link) for the early-settle pilot for signature. Once signed, we can run one test invoice on Sept 27 as proposed and pay under the pilot terms on Sept 30.

Marissa — please send the portal mapping and the DocuSign link to the LumaPlex contacts today so they can review.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Partnerships (Onboarding)
Redwood Inference
